name: auditing-token-efficiency
description: Post-task retrospectives that turn token-inefficiency into scripts, MCP recommendations, and durable project documentation

interface.shortDescription: Turn task friction into a durable efficiency backlog
interface.longDescription: After a task finishes, review its tool calls and searches for repeated or expensive work, and record durable direction, structure, and an actionable token-efficiency backlog in the project's Documentation folder.
defaultPrompt: Audit the task just completed for token-efficiency improvements and update the project's Documentation folder.
